integrity: An analytic argument with a reproducible deterministic constant check and an explicitly approximate independent coarse-grid simulation. No independent external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed symmetric stable index strictly below 2, fixed positive Poisson reset rate, and fixed interior start ratio; only a large-interval weak limit. No finite-size error bound and no Gaussian endpoint. The exponential lifetime and side marginals have known antecedents, and publication priority of the joint mark theorem requires expert review.
title: A marked rare-escape law for Lévy flights with Poisson resetting
